# High Peak Sports

> High Peak Sports is a specialized B2B manufacturing venture based in Sialkot, Pakistan, focused on custom sportswear, goalkeeper gloves, and embroidered PVC patches for global brands, clubs, and teams.

## Core Offerings
- Custom PVC Patches & Emblems
- Performance Goalkeeper Gloves
- Custom Sportswear & Teamwear
- Private Label Manufacturing
